q: Peraturan Pendedahan Bising 2019 mengandungi berapa peruntukan utama (salient provisions)?
e: Salient provisions: 1 Citation … 12 Penalty (12 peruntukan).

q: Unit dB(A) ialah aras tekanan bunyi yang diperbetulkan mengikut skala frekuensi berpemberat-A dengan tekanan bunyi rujukan:
e: dB(A): A-weighted decibel, reference sound pressure level of 20 micropascals (IEC characteristics).

q: Aras tekanan bunyi puncak (peak SPL) ialah:
c: Aras tekanan bunyi serta-merta berpemberat-C tertinggi bagi sebarang bunyi hentaman
e: Peak sound pressure level: the highest C-weighted instantaneous sound pressure level of any impact.

q: 'Pendedahan bising' (noise exposure) merujuk kepada jumlah tekanan bunyi yang didedahkan kepada:
e: Noise exposure: the amount of sound pressure exposed to a person's unprotected ear.

q: 'Abnormal audiogramme' ialah audiogram yang menunjukkan:
c: Kehilangan pendengaran, kecacatan pendengaran atau anjakan ambang piawai kekal
e: Abnormal audiogramme: shows hearing loss, hearing impairment or permanent standard threshold shift.

q: Pengenalpastian bising berlebihan perlu dikaji semula apabila:
c: Terdapat perubahan pada jentera, peralatan, proses atau langkah kawalan
e: Identification reviewed when: (a) change in machinery, equipment, process, work, control measures or operation; (b) after 1 year; (c) directed by DG.

q: Bagi bising berlebihan, aras tekanan bunyi maksimum tidak boleh melebihi pada bila-bila masa:
e: Excessive noise: Leq 82 dB(A), dose 50%, maximum SPL 115 dB(A) at any time, peak SPL 140 dB(C).

q: Alat pengukur bising yang digunakan oleh Penilai Risiko Bising mestilah mematuhi piawaian:
e: NRA: conduct noise risk assessment using noise measuring equipment comply to IEC.

q: Laporan penilai risiko bising perlu mengandungi:
e: NRA report includes the findings and recommendations made based on assessment; submitted to employer within 1 month.

q: Maklumat, arahan dan latihan kepada pekerja yang terdedah kepada bising berlebihan meliputi:
c: Kesan pendedahan bising dan keperluan ujian audiometri
e: Reg. 5: effects of noise exposure and requirement to undergo audiometric testing; proper usage of PHP; supervise noise control implementation.

q: 'Daily Personal Noise Dose' ialah pendedahan bising kumulatif pekerja yang diperbetulkan bagi hari kerja normal selama:
e: Daily Personal Noise Dose means cumulative noise exposure corrected for a normal working day of 8 hours.

q: Jika kawalan kejuruteraan TIDAK praktikal, langkah pengurangan bising seterusnya ialah:
e: Assessment: practicable → engineering control; not practicable (eng.) → engineering and administrative control; not practicable (eng. & admin) → administrative; else other effective measures.

q: Pelindung pendengaran peribadi (PHP) yang dibekalkan perlu dapat:
c: Mengurangkan pendedahan bising peribadi pekerja ke bawah NEL
e: PHP: suitable & efficient, inspected & maintained, reasonably attenuate personal noise exposure below NEL, approved by DG.

q: Dalam zon perlindungan pendengaran, majikan mesti memastikan:
c: PHP disediakan dan digunakan oleh sesiapa yang berada dalam zon
e: Hearing protection zone: provide PHP in each zone; any employee or other person to use PHP while in the zone.

q: Siapakah yang mentafsir audiogram di bawah Peraturan Bising 2019?
e: Audiometric testing: employer appoints OHD to interpret audiogramme; OHD carries out medical examination for abnormal audiogramme.

q: Majikan perlu memaklumkan pekerja tentang keputusan ujian audiometri dalam tempoh:
e: Notify employee of the audiometric testing result within 21 days after receiving the report.

q: Jika keputusan ujian menunjukkan NIHL berkaitan pekerjaan, majikan perlu memaklumkan Pengarah JKKP terdekat dalam tempoh:
e: When result shows occupational NIHL, HI or PSTS: notify Director of nearest DOSH office within 7 days; provide PHP; train employee.

q: Kos ujian audiometri pekerja ditanggung oleh:
e: Duty of employer when audiometric testing is carried out: no cost to the employee.

q: 'Senyap' (quiet) sebelum ujian audiometri bermaksud ketiadaan pendedahan kepada aras bunyi melebihi:
e: Testing only in quiet state of at least 14 hours without PHP; 'quiet' – absence of exposure to sound level exceeding 80 dB(A).

q: Laporan ujian audiometri pekerja perlu disimpan sepanjang tempoh pekerjaannya dan:
e: Records: NRA report not less than 30 years; audiometric testing report during employment and 5 years after employee ceased.
